You are doing a read-only verification pass for a technical design document, against Confluence. Confluence is at zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net, space SFCC. Use the mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_* tools (if deferred, load first via ToolSearch, query "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search"). Do NOT modify anything. For each item report VERIFIED (page-id + section + exact evidence/quote), CHANGED, DISCREPANCY, or COULD-NOT-VERIFY. Be exhaustive and quote the relevant text.

VERIFY THESE PAGES/FACTS:
1. Page 318472193 "Contentful CMS — Setup & Operations": (a) the one-time bootstrap checklist — the status of "Add CI service account CMA token as GitHub Actions secret" (item ~9): is it marked Complete or Incomplete? (b) confirms single Contentful Space + one Environment per delivery tier (dev→test→sit→staging→uat→production); (c) confirms 9 locales; (d) opens with "Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001)".
2. Page 256835585 "Technical Solution Design – PWA": (a) §12.1 "Blast-Radius Containment" — quote the exact Contentful bullet (it should say the contentful v11 SDK "does not expose a `dispatcher` hook ... connection isolation for Contentful is not achievable through this pattern. Primary mitigation is the graceful degradation rule in §12"); (b) confirm it classifies Contentful as "browser-direct"; (c) confirm storefront count = 8 in 6 regions; (d) confirm a §9.3 exists (performance measurement / where pools are validated).
3. Page 292061208 "TSD: Product — SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration": confirm it states product images load directly into SFCC (SFCC BM), no external DAM (around §4.3 / §9).
4. Page 302186497 "DC002" (Product Images Location decision): confirm it is EMPTY / no decision recorded.
5. Page 303890433 "Third Party Integrations": confirm it references a Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and/or Delivery API connector.
6. Page 268337165 "Third Party Credentials": confirm Contentful must provide per-environment credentials (Space ID, CDA/CPA tokens, webhook secret) as a blocker; and confirm whether New Relic appears on this tracker (expected: absent).
7. Page 303071234 "04.1.1 Homepage and Content": confirm HPC-001 exists and relates to Contentful being the CMS; look for any statement that product/category references are "authored via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and resolved at render (HPC-001)".
8. Page 339935324 "CDN, eCDN & Security Configuration": confirm it holds the "Log Centre → New Relic" streaming checklist and references an Accenture "Observability, Tracing & Security Assurance" deck; and that those checklist items are incomplete (designed, not configured).
9. Also search the SFCC space for any page that explicitly defines a rule for WHEN to use Contentful "Studio Experiences" vs coded/hand-built React content-type components. Report whether such a rule exists anywhere in Confluence (expected: it does not).

Return a structured checklist with page-id, the exact quote/evidence, and the verdict for each.
